sentences: IEEE-754 binary64 numeric class test against the 10-bit mask (`0` sNaN, `1` qNaN, `2` `-inf`, `3` `-normal`, `4` `-subnormal`, `5` `-0`, `6` `+0`, `7` `+subnormal`, `8` `+normal`, `9` `+inf`), lowered in `Gen.cmp_class_f64` using pure 32-bit `%uint` bit extraction on `(lo, hi)` with no `Float64` capability required.

Supports VGPR/SGPR pairs, float inline constants (`fimm`), sign-extended inline integers (`-16..64`), 32-bit literals placed in bits `[63:32]` (as on RDNA2), and VOP3 `abs`/`neg` sign-bit modifiers on `src0` (`abs` clears bit 63, `neg` flips bit 63 without quieting sNaN).
Inactive lanes produce 0 for `v_cmp_class_f64` and stay inactive for `v_cmpx_class_f64`.

CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_cmp_class_f64.py` (all 10 classes with low- and high-word payload bits, mask combinations and high-bit ignores, SGPR pairs, `fimm`/inline/literal constants, `abs`/`neg`/`-\|x\|`, `v_cmpx_class_f64` EXEC narrowing, inactive lanes, no `Float64` capability, bad-operand rejections).
